en-US.title: Market Street: Cozy Shops
en-US.subtitle: Bake, sell, grow your street
en-US.promoText: Start with one bread stall on a quiet town square. Bake, fill orders and grow it into a whole street of shops. No adverts, and it plays offline.
en-US.description:
Start with one bread stall on a quiet town square, and grow it into a street the whole town loves.

Market Street is a calm, cozy shop game you can play a few minutes at a time. Bake a loaf, fill an order, earn a few coins, and open the next shop. Come back later and your goods are ready and waiting.

RUN FIVE LITTLE SHOPS
Open a bakery, a dairy, a flower stall, a preserves shop and a café. Each one makes eight goods, from bread rolls and butter to bouquets, lemon curd and afternoon tea. 40 goods in all.

FILL ORDERS FOR THE TOWN
The order board always has someone who needs something. Fill orders to earn coins and experience, and climb through 25 levels.

BRING THE SQUARE BACK TO LIFE
Restore the fountain, the clock tower and the bandstand, stage by stage. Each one makes your street a little better for good.

A STREET THAT FEELS ALIVE
Customers wander in, queue at your shops and leave a tip when you tap them. Every shop, good and landmark is hand painted.

PLAYS AT YOUR PACE
• Your shops keep working while you are away
• Daily goals and a login calendar that never punishes a missed day
• Optional reminders: two a day at most, never at night
• Plays offline
• No adverts, ever

Market Street is free to play. You can buy gems to finish things sooner, but everything in the game can be earned by playing.

en-US.releaseNotes: Welcome to Market Street! Open your first stall and start baking.

review.notes:
Market Street is a single-player idle shop game. It needs no account and no sign-in.

To see the main loop: tap the bread stall, make a loaf, collect it, then open the order board (bottom of the screen) and fill an order. The first minutes are guided by an in-game tutorial.

In-app purchases: gems are bought in the gem shop, opened by tapping the gem counter at the top of the screen. Gems are spent to finish a batch at once or to add a queue slot to a shop. Nothing bought is random; there are no loot boxes. Restore purchases is in Settings (the cog at the top of the screen).

Deleting data: Settings > Delete my data removes the saved game from the device and from our backup.

Notifications are local only, off by default, and asked for only when the player turns them on in Settings. The game has no adverts and does not track users.
